comment: Conformance cases for checkers and checklist runs (SPEC.md §9). Data only. Each case gives the item, the state of each source, and the expected result and reason codes. Every case also requires: no use of 'safe' or 'guaranteed', every source and date cited, and no free-text field printed. Injection strings below are deliberate test inputs.

cases.note: The fixed known-vulnerable OSV canary package is absent from the batch response.
Google's published Safe Browsing test URL must come back listed; otherwise the source counts as failed.

cases.note: The extractor prints has_postinstall=true only. readme, description and the script body never reach the AI.
